newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: NSTP sells CAHB stake for $387m.
newsitem.headline: NSTP sells CAHB stake for $387m.

text.p: The New Straits Times Press (M) Bhd has sold its 20.17 percent stake in Commerce Asset-Holding Bhd (COMM.KL) to FCW Holdings Bhd (FCW), the Business Times reported on Saturday.
The deal, worth more than 968 million ringgit ($387 million), consists of 56.25 million shares at 16 ringgit each and 7.25 million transferable subscription rights at 9.50 ringgit.
The transfer of ownership of the biggest stake in Malaysia's sixth largest banking group was concluded in an agreement late on Friday, the newspaper said.
NSTP, which held the 20.17 percent stake through wholly-owned subsidiary Pitisan Sdn Bhd, was expected to make a capital gain of 698.5 million ringgit from the deal, the Business times said.
Under the agreement, FCW will pay 90 percent, or about 872 million ringgit, in cash.
The remaining 10 percent will be settled through the issue of 21.53 million new FCW shares at 4.50 ringgit each.
